cjsChainModules.description: Internal chain/setup modules the bridges register under dsh-bridge-setup/* so each vendored CJS file gets its own evaluation scope (ESM import order is depth-first with bodies interleaved only BETWEEN modules — captures inside one module's body run only after ALL its imports, measured: shell.js saw no './grammars/shell' face). Every file of a chain gets its exports object PRE-REGISTERED before evaluation, so CJS cycles see each other's live partially-filled exports exactly like a real CJS loader (__dshCjsSetup binds the ambient module/exports for the file evaluated next; __dshCjsKeep re-points the key when a file REBINDS module.exports).

piAiModelShadows.description: PI_AI_MODEL_SHADOWS: 39 generated provider catalog files x TWO names each = 78 runtime-module registrations (checked before disk loads for absolute /vendor names, so a runtime module registered under the ABSOLUTE vendor path of a generated providers/<id>.models.js REPLACES that file for every importer while all other files keep loading VERBATIM). Each shadow source is the generated file's own 3-line shape with the JSON import attribute rewritten to the __dshBundleRequire JSON seam. TWO names per file because dsh_resolve_relative tokenizes a slash-prefixed importer directory into a leading EMPTY segment, so its join produces the NO-slash spelling — relative re-entry never carries the slash.
